mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES rebounds from its sharp t-1w drop while TRANSIT stabilizes, weekday trip chaining should increase retail visits and lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises at least 10 points from its recent low and stays above -25 for two weeks
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell to -38.3 at t-1w then improved to -12.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not move above its last-4-week mean even after WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both improve for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained shift toward higher RESIDENTIAL mobility indicates more time spent at home, which reduces discretionary shopping trips and pushes RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL remains positive across all four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its prior four-week average while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated for at least three consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT falls below -15 after already being weak, access frictions suppress spontaneous shopping and RETAIL_REC declines within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT crosses below -15 after a prior week above -10
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT was -18.1 at t-1w and -9.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases for two straight weeks after TRANSIT breaches -15 and remains below that level.

mechanism_narrative: A positive PARKS shock together with higher GROCERY_PHARM implies weekend leisure and errand traffic, which spills into nearby retail activity and raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS turned positive at t-1w and remained positive at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays flat or declines despite PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM both remaining above zero for two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL both stay elevated, routine local trips substitute for discretionary retail, so RETAIL_REC weakens over the next one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM stays above 10 while RESIDENTIAL stays above 3
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM was 14.3 and RESIDENTIAL was 3.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises even though both GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL remain above the stated thresholds for two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid drop in WORKPLACES below -25 signals intensified work-from-home or workplace disruption, which cuts lunch and after-work retail demand and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls below -25 for at least one week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall below its previous four-week mean within four weeks of WORKPLACES crossing below -25.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS remains positive while TRANSIT stays depressed, leisure trips are more likely to be local and non-retail, so retail demand softens after a short lag.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -10 while PARKS is above 5
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS was 7.0 at t-1w and 6.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises within one week even though PARKS remains above 5 and TRANSIT remains below -10.

mechanism_narrative: In the holiday-shopping regime, a broad lift in GROCERY_PHARM combined with stable or improving TRANSIT should precede higher RETAIL_REC as households consolidate errands and shopping trips.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises for two consecutive weeks and TRANSIT improves from the prior week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to exceed its last-four-week mean within two weeks after GROCERY_PHARM rises two weeks in a row and TRANSIT improves.
